subject: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@nexora.ai>
Cc: Sam Whitaker <sam.whitaker@nexora.ai>
Date: Wed, Feb 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora

Hi Priya (cc Sam),

We’re rolling out a small beta of a new Redwood Console view called **Suggestions**. It surfaces automated recommendations for **batching and caching** with an estimated savings range and an explicit risk level (low/medium/high), so teams can make changes confidently.

We’d like to invite Nexora into the beta cohort.

What you’ll get in beta
- A Suggestions list filtered by route/model/region
- A detail drawer that explains what to change and why it helps
- Estimated impact (e.g., $/1M tokens + monthly projection) + “basis of estimate” section
- Risk level + rationale (latency/quality/SLO considerations)

What beta is / isn’t
- **Read-only** in phase 1 (no one-click “apply” yet)
- Suggestions are generated from your existing usage + metering; if telemetry is insufficient you may see “insufficient data” for some routes

Enablement (takes ~5 minutes)
1) Reply with your Redwood **workspace/org ID** (or the workspace name if that’s easier and we can look it up).
2) Confirm who should have access (we can start with Admins only).
3) We’ll allowlist the workspace for the `suggestions_beta` flag. It will show up in Console under **Optimize → Suggestions**.

Feedback expectations (lightweight)
- 20–30 min walkthrough in week 1
- 10 min async feedback after you’ve used it (what felt trustworthy vs confusing)
- If you choose to adopt a suggestion, we’ll compare estimated vs realized savings and share results back with you

If you’re open to it, can you share 2–3 times next week for a walkthrough? Alternatively, I can propose a few slots.

Thanks,
Aditya

Aditya Rao
Product, Redwood Optimize
Redwood Inference


---

From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@nexora.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Whitaker <sam.whitaker@nexora.ai>
Date: Wed, Feb 4, 2026 at 12:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora

Hi Aditya,

Yes, interested.

A few questions before we enable:
1) Can you confirm nothing will be automatically applied? We want to review anything that could affect latency.
2) Who can see this view? We have some internal separation where only the platform team should see cost/usage-derived data.
3) Does the estimate reveal any sensitive per-customer usage patterns (we’re multi-tenant on our side)?

Workspace: `nexora-prod` (ID: ws_8f3c2a1d)

For access, please start with Admins + our platform group only if that’s supported.

Next week times: Tue 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT.

Thanks,
Priya


---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@nexora.ai>
Cc: Sam Whitaker <sam.whitaker@nexora.ai>
Date: Wed, Feb 4, 2026 at 2:06 PM PST
Subject: Re: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora

Hi Priya,

Great questions — quick answers:

1) Automatic changes
- Confirmed: **nothing is auto-applied** in this beta. It’s strictly read-only. We’re intentionally holding “apply” workflows until we have guardrails/rollbacks and more validation.

2) Who can see it
- Access is scoped by RBAC. We can restrict to Admins and users with the permission for viewing optimization suggestions. If you tell me the name of the “platform group” (or the roles you want), we’ll align access to that.

3) Sensitivity of estimates
- The UI shows aggregated cost/latency/token-derived metrics at the **route/model/region** level. It does **not** expose end-customer identifiers.
- We also audit-log access to the Suggestions view (who accessed + workspace), which helps with internal controls.

I’ll get `ws_8f3c2a1d` allowlisted for `suggestions_beta` and will confirm once it’s live.

For the walkthrough: let’s do **Thu 2:30pm PT** if that works (30 min). If you prefer Tue, I can do Tue 10:30am PT.

Also sharing the beta overview doc (includes limitations + how to interpret risk/savings):
https://docs.redwoodinference.com/console/suggestions-beta

Thanks,
Aditya


---

From: Sam Whitaker <sam.whitaker@nexora.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@nexora.ai>
Date: Thu, Feb 5, 2026 at 9:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora

Hi Aditya,

Thu 2:30pm PT works.

Could you include in the agenda:
- What telemetry is required (we’ve seen “insufficient data” style issues in other tools)
- How you avoid double counting when batching + caching both apply
- What “High risk” typically means in concrete terms

Also, our platform group is an RBAC role on your side named `nexora-platform`.

Thanks,
Sam


---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Whitaker <sam.whitaker@nexora.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@nexora.ai>
Date: Fri, Feb 6, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Invitation: Redwood Console Suggestions (beta) for Nexora

Sounds good — invite coming shortly for Thu 2:30pm PT.

Agenda (30 min)
1) Quick tour: Optimize → Suggestions (list, filters, detail drawer)
2) Telemetry requirements + freshness expectations (what causes “insufficient data”)
3) Savings model overview (including avoiding double counting between batching/caching)
4) Risk levels: concrete drivers + how to interpret “High risk” + reversibility
5) Feedback loop: what we track (viewed/adopted) + how we’ll validate estimated vs realized savings

Enablement update
- We’ve allowlisted `ws_8f3c2a1d` and will scope access to Admins + `nexora-platform`.
- You should see the entry in Console within the next hour (may require a refresh / re-login).

Attachment: Redwood_Suggestions_Beta_OnePager.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya

Aditya Rao
Product, Redwood Optimize
Redwood Inference

Meeting details (calendar invite to follow)
- When: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 2:30–3:00pm PT
- Where: Google Meet (link in invite)
